produces: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
included.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.
included.prerequisites:
Gilraen does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
